sentences.text: A video of Bill Gates suggesting that robots should be taxed is going viral in the news and social media.
sentences.translation: 比尔·盖茨提议对机器人征税的一段视频，正在新闻和社交媒体上迅速走红。
sentences.paraphrase: A video in which Bill Gates proposes taxing robots is spreading rapidly through news outlets and social media.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: 先找到主语中心 video 与谓语 is going viral。suggesting 不是主句谓语；that 从句是 suggesting 的内容，其中 should be taxed 为情态动词被动结构。

clauses: Bill Gates suggesting … 修饰 video 中呈现的内容
functions: A video of Bill Gates suggesting that robots should be taxed
in the news and social media.
sentences.note: 先找到主语中心 video 与谓语 is going viral。suggesting 不是主句谓语；that 从句是 suggesting 的内容，其中 should be taxed 为情态动词被动结构。

reuse.pattern: A video of ___ suggesting that ___ is ___.
reuse.zh: 一段老师建议学生记录问题的视频正在网上走红。
reuse.en: A video of a teacher suggesting that students keep a question journal is going viral.
reuse.note: suggesting 修饰视频中的人；that 引出建议内容。

pdfNotes.title: 论证路线
pdfNotes.text: 讲义导图梳理为：机器人税与基本收入的争论 → 工业史与人口变化 → 税收和转型速度的异议 → 同理心与社会责任。历史类比支持作者的判断，并不能单独证明每位失业者都会找到新工作。

pdfNotes.title: go viral 的语义重点
pdfNotes.text: go viral 强调内容经网络迅速传播；catch on 强调开始流行，take off 强调迅速成功。讲义中的 blow across the internet 不作为固定搭配背诵。

sentences.text: This idea of universal income and taxing robots is gaining ground.
sentences.translation: 这种全民收入与向机器人征税的想法，正逐渐获得支持。
sentences.paraphrase: The proposal to provide income for everyone and tax robots is attracting growing support.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: 主语中心是单数 idea，所以用 is。and 连接 of 后的两项内容；taxing 为非谓语，不构成另一个限定从句。

clauses: of universal income and taxing robots
functions: This idea of universal income and taxing robots
sentences.note: 主语中心是单数 idea，所以用 is。and 连接 of 后的两项内容；taxing 为非谓语，不构成另一个限定从句。

reuse.pattern: This idea of ___ is gaining ground.
reuse.zh: 共享学习空间的想法正逐渐得到支持。
reuse.en: This idea of shared study spaces is gaining ground.

pdfNotes.title: 基本收入与芬兰试验
pdfNotes.text: universal basic income 指面向所有人、定期发放且不以就业或收入审查为条件的基本收入。讲义所举芬兰试验在 2017–2018 年向 2,000 名失业者每月发放 560 欧元；它是特定人群试验，不能说芬兰已向全民发放基本收入。

sentences.text: Sometime in June, a draft report was submitted to the European Parliament that states:
sentences.translation: 六月的某个时候，一份草案报告被提交给欧洲议会，报告中写道：
sentences.paraphrase: At some point in June, a draft report containing the following proposal was presented to the European Parliament.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: that states 修饰 report，因介词短语插入而与先行词分离。不是“欧洲议会写道”。冒号引出下一条音频中的报告内容，保留现有分句。

clauses: a draft report was submitted to the European Parliament
sentences.note: that states 修饰 report，因介词短语插入而与先行词分离。不是“欧洲议会写道”。冒号引出下一条音频中的报告内容，保留现有分句。

reuse.pattern: Sometime in ___, a report that ___ was submitted to ___.
reuse.zh: 六月的某个时候，一份讨论空气质量的报告提交给了委员会。
reuse.en: Sometime in June, a report that discussed air quality was submitted to the committee.
reuse.note: 练习把定语从句放回 report 后，便于清晰表达。

pdfNotes.title: sometime / sometimes / some time
pdfNotes.text: sometime：某个时候；sometimes：有时；some time：一段时间。表示“几次”通常用 a few times / several times，不把 some times 当作常用频率表达。submit a report to… 是“向……提交报告”；state 在此是动词“陈述”。

pdfNotes.title: 两个欧盟机构
pdfNotes.text: European Parliament 是欧洲议会；European Commission 是欧盟委员会。原句是报告提交给议会，并建议委员会采取行动，两者不能合并成同一机构。

sentences.text: If advanced robots start replacing human workers in large numbers, the report recommends the European Commission force their owners to pay taxes or contribute to social security.
sentences.translation: 如果先进机器人开始大量取代人类工人，报告建议欧盟委员会要求机器人的所有者缴税或缴纳社会保障费用。
sentences.paraphrase: The report advises requiring robot owners to pay taxes or social security contributions if advanced robots replace large numbers of workers.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: force 是建议型从句中的虚拟式原形，不因 Commission 单数而加 -s；也可用 should force，但不是必须补回一个被删的 should。force their owners to pay or contribute 中两动词共用 to。

clauses: If advanced robots start replacing human workers in large numbers
(that) the European Commission force their owners …
functions: If advanced robots start replacing human workers in large numbers,
the European Commission force their owners to pay taxes or contribute to social security.
sentences.note: force 是建议型从句中的虚拟式原形，不因 Commission 单数而加 -s；也可用 should force，但不是必须补回一个被删的 should。force their owners to pay or contribute 中两动词共用 to。

reuse.pattern: If ___, the report recommends that ___ do ___.
reuse.zh: 如果需求继续增长，报告建议学校增开两门课程。
reuse.en: If demand continues to grow, the report recommends that the school offer two more courses.
reuse.note: 要求类从句用 offer 原形；也可用 should offer。

pdfNotes.title: recommend 后的原形动词
pdfNotes.text: the European Commission 是从句主语，force 是要求类虚拟语气的动词原形；也可用 should force。不是因为 Commission 是复数。常用 recommend doing / recommend that somebody (should) do；Oxford 也收录 recommend somebody to do，不能一概判错。

pdfNotes.title: 两个欧盟机构
pdfNotes.text: European Parliament 是欧洲议会；European Commission 是欧盟委员会。原句是报告提交给议会，并建议委员会采取行动，两者不能合并成同一机构。

sentences.text: The establishment of a basic income, or guaranteed welfare program, is also suggested as a protection against human unemployment.
sentences.translation: 还建议设立基本收入——也就是有保障的福利计划——以防范人类失业带来的风险。
sentences.paraphrase: A guaranteed basic income or welfare scheme is also proposed to protect people against unemployment.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: 主语中心 establishment 为单数。or 在逗号间引出对 basic income 的换说，不连接两个独立主句。against 表示防范的对象。

functions: The establishment of a basic income, or guaranteed welfare program,
as a protection against human unemployment.
sentences.note: 主语中心 establishment 为单数。or 在逗号间引出对 basic income 的换说，不连接两个独立主句。against 表示防范的对象。

reuse.pattern: The establishment of ___ is suggested as ___.
reuse.zh: 建立互助小组被建议作为支持新生的一种方式。
reuse.en: The establishment of a peer group is suggested as a way to support new students.

pdfNotes.title: guaranteed 的词性
pdfNotes.text: guaranteed 在 guaranteed welfare program 中修饰 program，表示“有保障的”。词典中“确定会发生的”对应形容词 guaranteed；动词 guarantee 的核心是“保证、担保”。

sentences.text: I see robots as tools that make a job easier or do things much faster or much better or much cheaper.
sentences.translation: 我把机器人看作工具：它们使工作更容易，或把事情做得更快、更好、更便宜。
sentences.paraphrase: To me, robots are tools that simplify work or perform tasks faster, better or more cheaply.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: that 指 tools，作从句主语；make 与 do 并列。make a job easier 为宾语＋形容词宾补；much 修饰比较级。cheaper 在这里作比较方式表达。

clauses: that make a job easier or do things …
functions: as tools that make a job easier or do things much faster or much better or much cheaper.
sentences.note: that 指 tools，作从句主语；make 与 do 并列。make a job easier 为宾语＋形容词宾补；much 修饰比较级。cheaper 在这里作比较方式表达。

reuse.zh: 我把笔记看作帮助我建立联系的工具。
reuse.en: I see notes as tools that help me make connections.

pdfNotes.title: 工具怎样发挥作用
pdfNotes.text: see robots as tools 中 as tools 是对 robots 的身份说明；that 引导定语从句修饰 tools，其中 make…easier 与 do…faster/better/cheaper 并列。easier 描述 job，faster 等说明做事方式。

sentences.text: Throughout human history, we have used various forms of tools, from stone to metal to water to air to wood to coal to oil, and to electricity to achieve transformations in our lives.
sentences.translation: 纵观人类历史，我们使用了各种工具，从石头、金属、水、空气、木材、煤、石油直到电力，以改变生活。
sentences.paraphrase: Throughout history, people have used many kinds of tools and sources of power to change their lives.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: 只有 have used 一个限定谓语。to metal 等的 to 是介词；最后 to achieve 的 to 是不定式标记。长列举不使句子自动成为复合句。

clauses: we have used various forms of tools
to achieve transformations in our lives
functions: from stone to metal to water to air to wood to coal to oil, and to electricity
to achieve transformations in our lives.
sentences.note: 只有 have used 一个限定谓语。to metal 等的 to 是介词；最后 to achieve 的 to 是不定式标记。长列举不使句子自动成为复合句。

reuse.zh: 我们利用简单的实验来加深理解。
reuse.en: We have used simple experiments to achieve a deeper understanding.

sentences.text: During each of these stages, there were a lot of people who lost their jobs and the next generation learned new skills to stay relevant.
sentences.translation: 在这些阶段中，总有许多人失去工作，而下一代学习新技能以适应变化。
sentences.paraphrase: At every stage, many people lost work, while the following generation acquired new skills to remain useful.

classification.label: 并列复合句
classification.reason: 既有主句间的并列，又有内部或外部的限定从句。
classification.note: who 从句止于 jobs。and 后出现新的主语 the next generation 与谓语 learned，是并列主句，不能把它整个归入 who 定语从句。

clauses: there were a lot of people who lost their jobs
the next generation learned new skills to stay relevant
functions: a lot of people who lost their jobs
sentences.note: who 从句止于 jobs。and 后出现新的主语 the next generation 与谓语 learned，是并列主句，不能把它整个归入 who 定语从句。

reuse.pattern: There were people who ___, and the next generation ___.
reuse.zh: 曾有人靠手工织布谋生，而下一代学会了使用机器。
reuse.en: There were people who made a living by weaving by hand, and the next generation learned to use machines.
reuse.note: who 从句在逗号前结束。

pdfNotes.title: who 从句的结束位置
pdfNotes.text: who lost their jobs 只修饰 people。and 后 the next generation 是另一主句的主语；不要把 learned 也纳入 who 从句。

pdfNotes.title: relevant 与例证信号
pdfNotes.text: relevant 强调与当前需要或问题切题、有用；related 只表示存在联系。a case in point 引出能说明当前论点的具体例子。

sentences.text: A case in point is below:
sentences.translation: 下面就是一个切合的例子：
sentences.paraphrase: The following example illustrates this point.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: 冒号引出后面的例证。below 是方位副词，不是省略了 that 的从句；这一条沿用现有音频边界。

clauses: A case in point is below:
sentences.note: 冒号引出后面的例证。below 是方位副词，不是省略了 that 的从句；这一条沿用现有音频边界。

reuse.zh: 一个典型例子就是共享单车的兴起。
reuse.en: A case in point is the rise of bike sharing.

pdfNotes.title: relevant 与例证信号

sentences.text: Textile factories organized workers' lives much differently from craft production.
sentences.translation: 纺织厂组织工人生活的方式，与手工业生产大不相同。
sentences.paraphrase: Working in textile factories shaped workers' lives very differently from producing goods by hand.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: differently 是副词，修饰 organized；much 加强差异。比较对象在语义上是两种生产方式如何安排工人生活。

sentences.note: differently 是副词，修饰 organized；much 加强差异。比较对象在语义上是两种生产方式如何安排工人生活。

reuse.zh: 线上课程安排讨论的方式与传统课堂不同。
reuse.en: Online courses organized discussions differently from traditional classes.

pdfNotes.title: 手工业与工厂的对照
pdfNotes.text: 讲义的织机图片对应 handloom 手织机。对照重点是工人从自行决定工具、地点与节奏，转向工厂集中安排；不能仅归纳成“机器使生产变快”。

sentences.text: Handloom weavers worked at their own pace, with their own tools, and within their own cottages.
sentences.translation: 手织工按自己的节奏，用自己的工具，在自己的小屋里工作。
sentences.paraphrase: Weavers using hand-operated looms worked in their own homes, with their own equipment, at a pace they chose.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: and 连接三个介词短语中的最后一项，不连接从句。三个 own 反复突出生产者的自主性。

clauses: at their own pace / with their own tools / within their own cottages
sentences.note: and 连接三个介词短语中的最后一项，不连接从句。三个 own 反复突出生产者的自主性。

reuse.zh: 学生按自己的节奏，使用自己的笔记，在小组内完成任务。
reuse.en: The students worked at their own pace, with their own notes, and within small groups.

pdfNotes.title: 手工业与工厂的对照
pdfNotes.text: 讲义的织机图片对应 handloom 手织机。对照重点是工人从自行决定工具、地点与节奏，转向工厂集中安排；不能仅归纳成“机器使生产变快”。

pdfNotes.title: pace 与 machinery
pdfNotes.text: at one's own pace 按自己的节奏；keep pace with 跟上；set the pace 决定节奏。machinery 通常不可数，也可比喻机构的运作机制。

sentences.text: Factories set hours of work, and the machinery within them shaped the pace of work.
sentences.translation: 工厂规定了工时，而厂内的机器决定了工作的节奏。
sentences.paraphrase: Factories determined working hours, while their machines determined how fast people worked.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: 两个主语和两个限定谓语由 and 连接。within them 修饰 machinery；them 指 factories，不指 workers。

clauses: the machinery within them shaped the pace of work
sentences.note: 两个主语和两个限定谓语由 and 连接。within them 修饰 machinery；them 指 factories，不指 workers。

reuse.zh: 课程设定了目标，而学生的问题决定了讨论方向。
reuse.en: The course set the goals, and the students' questions shaped the discussion.

pdfNotes.title: pace 与 machinery
pdfNotes.text: at one's own pace 按自己的节奏；keep pace with 跟上；set the pace 决定节奏。machinery 通常不可数，也可比喻机构的运作机制。

sentences.text: Factories brought workers together within one building to work on machinery that they did not own.
sentences.translation: 工厂把工人集中到一座建筑中，让他们操作并不属于自己的机器。

classification.label: 主从复合句

classification.note: that 指 machinery，在 own 后作宾语，可省略。to work 的逻辑主语是 workers；work on 此处指操作／在机器上工作。

clauses: Factories brought workers together within one building
sentences.note: that 指 machinery，在 own 后作宾语，可省略。to work 的逻辑主语是 workers；work on 此处指操作／在机器上工作。

reuse.pattern: ___ brought ___ together to work on ___ that ___.
reuse.zh: 项目把研究者聚到一起，研究他们共同关心的问题。

sentences.text: Factories also increased the division of labor.
sentences.translation: 工厂还增加了劳动分工。
sentences.paraphrase: Factories also divided production into more specialized jobs.

classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: of labor 修饰 division。主谓宾清楚，可快速带过；理解重点是分工进一步细化。

clauses: Factories also increased the division of labor.

sentences.paraphrase: They reduced both how many tasks workers performed and how broad those tasks were.

clauses: They narrowed the number and scope of tasks.

vocabulary.definition: spread rapidly through online sharing — 在网上迅速传播、走红
collocations: a video goes viral 视频走红
go viral on social media 在社交媒体广泛传播
compare: go viral：强调网络分享带来的快速扩散
catch on：逐渐流行或被接受，不限网络
family: viral adj. 病毒的／网络疯传的
vocabulary.usage: go 在此是系动词，viral 是形容词；不能写成 go virally。本文不是感染病毒。

vocabulary.definition: including everyone in a group — 全民的；普遍适用的
collocations: universal basic income 全民基本收入
universal access 普遍享有的使用权
compare: widespread：分布广，但未必人人如此。
vocabulary.usage: 本文 universal income 指面向全体的收入保障。不要仅译成“普通收入”。
otherSenses: adj. true or present everywhere — 普遍存在的，如 universal appeal 普遍的吸引力

vocabulary.definition: become increasingly accepted or successful — 逐渐获得支持；取得进展
collocations: an idea gains ground 一种观点获得认可
gain ground on a rival 逐渐赶上对手
compare: gain ground：支持度或优势扩大
take hold：开始确立并产生影响。
vocabulary.usage: ground 在此不可数，不加 a 或 -s；对手用 on 引出。本文主语是 idea，不是土地。
otherSenses: move closer to a competitor — 缩小与对手的距离，常接 on

vocabulary.definition: a country's elected law-making body — 议会；国会
collocations: the European Parliament 欧洲议会
a member of parliament 议员
compare: congress：美国等国家立法机关的名称。
vocabulary.usage: 专名 European Parliament 首字母大写。本文接收报告的机构，不是 report 后 that 从句的先行词。

vocabulary.definition: an officially appointed body with particular duties — 委员会；专门管理机构
collocations: the European Commission 欧盟委员会
set up a commission 成立委员会
compare: commission：经正式任命并承担专门职责的机构
vocabulary.usage: 本文是专有机构名称。commission 也指“佣金”，此处不能套用这个义项。
otherSenses: n. payment based on sales — 佣金
n. an official task or request for a work — 委托任务、创作委托
v. formally ask for work to be done — 委托制作

vocabulary.definition: the state or level of being without paid work — 失业；失业状况
collocations: high unemployment 高失业率
reduce unemployment 降低失业率
unemployment benefits 失业救济金
compare: redundancy：职位不再需要导致的裁员
vocabulary.usage: 不可数，不说 an unemployment。the unemployed 可统指失业者，谓语用复数。

vocabulary.definition: cloth produced by weaving or similar processes — 纺织品；作定语指纺织业的
collocations: textile factories 纺织厂
the textile industry 纺织业
vocabulary.usage: textile factories 中 textile 作名词定语；不是说工厂本身是纺织品。

vocabulary.definition: skilled work, especially making things by hand — 手艺；手工制作
collocations: craft production 手工业生产
traditional crafts 传统手艺
craft skills 工艺技能
compare: manufacturing：产品的生产制造，常为规模化生产。
vocabulary.usage: 本文 craft production 与 factory production 对照。另有“船／飞行器”义，其复数常仍为 craft。
otherSenses: n. a boat, aircraft or spacecraft — 船、飞机或航天器，单复数同形
v. make with skill and care — 精心制作

vocabulary.definition: a loom operated by hand — 手动织布机
collocations: a handloom weaver 手织工
handloom weaving 手工织造
vocabulary.usage: handloom weavers 中修饰 weavers，指使用这种织机的工人。loom 作动词“隐约显现”是另一个义项。

vocabulary.definition: a person who weaves cloth or other materials — 织工；编织者
collocations: a handloom weaver 手织工
a silk weaver 丝织工
weave cloth 织布
compare: weaver：织造布或编织材料的人
vocabulary.usage: weave 的常见变化是 wove—woven。注意 weave 布料与 sew 缝制衣物不同。

vocabulary.definition: machines considered as a group — 机器设备的总称
collocations: industrial machinery 工业机械
operate machinery 操作机器
a piece of machinery 一台设备
compare: equipment：设备总称，范围不限机器。
vocabulary.usage: 不可数；不说 machineries 或 a machinery。本文 machinery 作主语时视为单数。
otherSenses: n. the organized workings of a system — 机构的运作机制，如 the machinery of government

vocabulary.definition: the range of what an activity covers — 范围；涉及面
collocations: the scope of a task 任务范围
broaden the scope 扩大范围
scope for improvement 改进余地
vocabulary.usage: 本文与 number 并列：任务的数量和范围是两个维度。scope for 指机会或余地，义项不同。
otherSenses: n. opportunity or freedom to develop — 施展空间、余地，常用 scope for

vocabulary.definition: a delay between related changes — 时间差；滞后
collocations: a time lag 时间滞后
lag behind 落后于
a lag between A and B 两者间的滞后
compare: lag：两个过程不同步形成的差距
vocabulary.usage: 本文 a lag 指旧工作消失与新技能适应之间的时间差，不特指时差反应 jet lag。
otherSenses: v. move or develop more slowly — 落后，常接 behind
n. a delay in a computer response — 电脑或网络响应延迟

vocabulary.definition: fail to include someone in progress — 使落后；使被抛下
collocations: leave people behind 把人落下
be left behind in development 在发展中掉队
compare: leave behind：从前进者角度说把人落下
fall behind：从落后者角度说跟不上
vocabulary.usage: 可分结构：leave them behind。本文用被动 will be left behind，强调部分人未分享到进步。
otherSenses: go away without taking somebody or something — 留下、落下、忘带
leave a lasting result — 遗留影响或痕迹

vocabulary.definition: an additional, often unintended result — 附带影响；副作用
collocations: a side effect of automation 自动化的附带影响
have side effects 有副作用
compare: side effect：主要结果以外的影响
by-product：过程中附带产生的事物。
vocabulary.usage: 不限药物副作用。本文讨论社会变化，原句措辞较笼统，需结合后文理解家庭规模变化。
otherSenses: n. an unintended effect of a medicine — 药物的副作用

vocabulary.definition: the use of machines or software to perform work automatically — 自动化
collocations: industrial automation 工业自动化
the impact of automation 自动化的影响
vocabulary.usage: 不可数。automatic 不一定表示先进的 AI；automation 也不等于完全无人参与。

vocabulary.definition: especially one member of a wider group — 尤其；特别是
collocations: men in particular 尤其是男性
nothing in particular 没什么特别的
compare: in particular：从一组中点出重点
particularly：单词副词，可直接修饰形容词
vocabulary.usage: 可放名词前后。本文 in particular 修饰 men，突出男性数量，不是“具体地”。

vocabulary.definition: economic success and material well-being — 繁荣；富足
collocations: economic prosperity 经济繁荣
a sign of prosperity 富足的标志
compare: prosperity：经济兴旺与生活富足的状态
vocabulary.usage: 不可数。本文是特定历史观念下的“富足标志”，不等于作者认同人口越多越富裕。

vocabulary.definition: experience a process or difficult period — 经历；经受
collocations: go through change 经历变化
go through a difficult phase 经历困难阶段
compare: go through：经历整个过程，常含困难
undergo：正式地经历改变或处理
experience：范围广，可指感受或事件。
vocabulary.usage: through 是介词，宾语放其后：go through it。另有“检查、用完”等义，本文取经历义。
otherSenses: examine carefully — 仔细检查
use up — 用完、耗尽
be officially accepted or completed — 获批、成交（go through，不带宾语）

vocabulary.definition: fall very quickly and sharply — 急剧下降；暴跌
collocations: birth rates plummet 出生率骤降
plummet from A to B 从 A 骤降到 B
compare: plummet：突出下降速度快、幅度大
vocabulary.usage: 常作不及物动词，不能把“使出生率下降”写成 plummet the birth rate。过去式 plummeted。
otherSenses: fall steeply through the air — 直坠
快速跌落

vocabulary.definition: restrict available choices or action — 限制；约束
collocations: be constrained by resources 受资源限制
budget constraints 预算约束
compare: constrain：外部条件限制行动空间
restrain：控制行为、情绪或用力阻止
vocabulary.usage: resource-constrained 中过去分词表示“受到资源条件限制的”。不是 constrained 去限制 world。
otherSenses: be forced by circumstances to act — 受迫做某事，较正式：be constrained to do

vocabulary.definition: use something effectively for a purpose — 有效利用；善加利用
collocations: put skills to good use 善用技能
be put to better use 得到更好利用
compare: put to use：使已有资源实际发挥作用
exploit：充分开发，也可含剥削意味。
vocabulary.usage: use 在此是名词 /juːs/，动词读 /juːz/。本文 has been put… 是现在完成时被动。

vocabulary.definition: for each person in a population — 人均地；人均的
collocations: per capita income 人均收入
GDP per capita 人均国内生产总值
family: 无须扩展词族：整组记忆 per capita
vocabulary.usage: 拉丁语来源，通常无冠词。人均数不表示每个人实际都得到该金额。

vocabulary.definition: cause an uneven or biased distribution — 使偏向；使分布不均
collocations: be skewed toward wealthy countries 向富国倾斜
skew the results 使结果失真
compare: distort：使形象或事实变形失真。
vocabulary.usage: toward/towards 均可。本文收入增长向发达国家集中，不只是“歪曲收入数字”。
otherSenses: distort facts or results — 歪曲事实、使结果失真
turn to an angle — 使偏斜、歪向一边

vocabulary.definition: a reason or set of reasons supporting a position — 论点；论据
collocations: an argument for taxation 支持征税的理由
an argument against a policy 反对政策的理由
compare: argument：支持立场的推理或理由
evidence：用来支持主张的事实或材料。
vocabulary.usage: 本文不是“吵架”。argue that 引出主张，argue for/against 引出支持／反对的对象。
otherSenses: n. an angry disagreement — 争吵、争执
n. a value passed to a function — 程序传入函数的参数（计算机语境）

vocabulary.definition: a large business organization — 公司；大企业
collocations: multinational corporations 跨国公司
corporate profits 公司利润
compare: firm：企业，常用于专业服务或商业机构。
vocabulary.usage: 本文 corporations 与其后 which pay higher taxes 对应。不要把 corporation 与 cooperation“合作”混淆。

vocabulary.definition: an issue or place likely to trigger conflict — 冲突焦点；导火索
collocations: a political flashpoint 政治冲突焦点
a flashpoint for unrest 动乱的导火索
vocabulary.usage: 本文指工作和税收可能转移到别处所引发的争议。不是化学义“闪点”。
otherSenses: n. the temperature at which vapour can ignite — 液体蒸气可被点燃的最低温度，闪点（技术义）

vocabulary.definition: refuse to buy or participate as a protest — 抵制；拒绝参加
collocations: boycott products 抵制产品
call for a boycott 呼吁抵制
compare: boycott：以拒买或拒参加表示抗议
vocabulary.usage: 动词直接接抵制的对象；名词常用 a boycott of sth.，不要把 ban 的“正式禁止”含义套进来。

vocabulary.definition: a car — 汽车
collocations: the automobile industry 汽车工业
automobile manufacturers 汽车制造商
compare: automobile：较正式，尤见美式行业用语
vocabulary.usage: 日常交流优先用 car。不要因 auto- 就理解成“自动驾驶汽车”。

vocabulary.definition: a particular type, often with distinctive qualities — 类型；一种新群体
collocations: a new breed of worker 新型劳动者
a rare breed 少见的一类人
compare: breed：突出一类事物的独特特征，常由动物品种引申
vocabulary.usage: 本文 a new breed of skills 是较有修辞色彩的说法，并非标准职业类别名称。
otherSenses: n. a type of domesticated animal — 品种
v. keep animals to produce young — 繁殖、培育
v. cause something to develop — 滋生、导致，如 breed resentment

vocabulary.definition: make an effect or signal stronger — 放大；增强
collocations: amplify an effect 放大效应
amplify a signal 放大信号
compare: amplify：增强已有声音、影响或问题
vocabulary.usage: 本文 amplifying 是分词补充说明；信息传播使影响更显著，不是单纯把音量调大。
otherSenses: make a sound louder — 扩大音量
add detail to an account — 进一步阐述（正式）

vocabulary.definition: make a task run automatically — 使自动化；实行自动化
collocations: automate a process 使流程自动化
automated production 自动化生产
compare: streamline：简化流程，不一定自动化。
vocabulary.usage: 本文 have always been automating 省略了具体宾语，强调人类长期持续推进自动化。

vocabulary.definition: interrupt a system's normal operation — 扰乱；打破原有运转
collocations: disrupt a system 扰乱系统
disrupt supply chains 扰乱供应链
compare: disrupt：正常过程受到明显干扰
destroy：破坏到不再存在或可用。
vocabulary.usage: get disrupted 是 get + 过去分词的被动结构。本文不是说整个社会被彻底毁灭。

vocabulary.definition: a state in which opposing forces are balanced — 均衡；平衡状态
collocations: reach equilibrium 达到均衡
restore equilibrium 恢复均衡
compare: equilibrium：系统内部力量相互平衡
vocabulary.usage: 正式用词。本文指技术冲击后的社会系统重新取得均衡，不能简单等同“恢复原样”。
otherSenses: n. physical balance — 身体平衡
n. emotional stability — 情绪平衡
n. a balance between supply and demand — 供需均衡

vocabulary.definition: understanding another person's feelings from their perspective — 共情；设身处地的理解
collocations: show empathy for others 对他人表示共情
empathise with workers 理解工人的处境
compare: empathy：从对方立场理解其感受
family: empathetic adj. 有共情能力的
vocabulary.usage: 不可数。empathy 不要求你赞同对方，也不意味着自己必须有完全相同的经历。

vocabulary.definition: concern for suffering together with a wish to help — 怜悯；体恤与助人之心
collocations: show compassion for people 体恤他人
treat someone with compassion 仁厚地对待某人
compare: pity：怜悯，有时带居高临下的感觉。
family: compassionate adj. 富有同情心的
vocabulary.usage: 本文与 empathy、social responsibility 并列，指面对转型阵痛应有的态度。

sentences.text: I came rather late to understanding myself in the cycle of life.
sentences.translation: 我很晚才开始理解自己在生命轮回中的位置。
sentences.paraphrase: It took me a long time to understand my own place in the course of a human life.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: come late to + 名词／-ing 表示很晚才接触或理解某事；to 是介词。不能套成“事情发展到不得不……”的 come to doing。

clauses: I came rather late to understanding myself …
functions: to understanding myself in the cycle of life.
sentences.note: come late to + 名词／-ing 表示很晚才接触或理解某事；to 是介词。不能套成“事情发展到不得不……”的 come to doing。

reuse.pattern: I came rather late to doing ___.
reuse.zh: 我很晚才开始欣赏诗歌。
reuse.en: I came rather late to appreciating poetry.
reuse.note: to 是介词，后接 appreciating。

pdfNotes.title: 导图中的时间线
pdfNotes.text: 童年同住 → 求学时再度同住 → 成家后遭遇危机 → 跟随祖父重新投入日常生活。叙述重点是“我”对祖父与自己的理解如何变化，末段回应开头的成长主题。

pdfNotes.title: come late to understanding
pdfNotes.text: come late to + 名词／doing 表示较晚才接触、达到或理解某事；to 是介词。come to understand 则是渐渐明白。结构并不只用于过去时或完成时。in relation to 在此保留“相对于祖父／在与祖父的关系中”的含义。

sentences.text: Until three years ago, I was a boy in relation to my grandfather.
sentences.translation: 直到三年前，在我与祖父的关系中，我仍然只是个孩子。
sentences.paraphrase: Until three years earlier, my relationship with my grandfather still made me feel like a boy.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: until 标明这种身份感持续到三年前。不是说作者实际年龄仍未成年，也不只是在转述祖父的看法。

clauses: I was a boy in relation to my grandfather.
sentences.note: until 标明这种身份感持续到三年前。不是说作者实际年龄仍未成年，也不只是在转述祖父的看法。

reuse.pattern: Until ___, I was ___ in relation to ___.
reuse.zh: 直到去年，相对于我的导师，我仍是个初学者。
reuse.en: Until last year, I was a beginner in relation to my mentor.

pdfNotes.title: come late to understanding
pdfNotes.text: come late to + 名词／doing 表示较晚才接触、达到或理解某事；to 是介词。come to understand 则是渐渐明白。结构并不只用于过去时或完成时。in relation to 在此保留“相对于祖父／在与祖父的关系中”的含义。

sentences.text: He lived to 107 and remained mentally and physically capable until the end of his life.
sentences.translation: 他活到了一百零七岁，直到生命的最后，身心仍然健全有力。
sentences.paraphrase: He reached the age of 107 and retained his mental and physical abilities to the very end.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: 同一 He 支配 lived 和 remained，按第一篇标准归简单句。mentally 和 physically 修饰 capable；to 107 表达到的年龄。

functions: until the end of his life.
sentences.note: 同一 He 支配 lived 和 remained，按第一篇标准归简单句。mentally 和 physically 修饰 capable；to 107 表达到的年龄。

reuse.zh: 她活到了九十五岁，直到最后仍保持好奇心。
reuse.en: She lived to ninety-five and remained curious until the end.

pdfNotes.title: remain / insist
pdfNotes.text: remain 后可接形容词作表语；remain to be done 是“仍有待完成”。insist on doing 指坚持做；insist that 若陈述事实用相应时态，若坚持要求才可能用 (should) do。

sentences.text: A generation after the last of his friends died, he could still mow the lawn on a hot summer afternoon, and he insisted on doing so.
sentences.translation: 最后一位老友去世整整一代人之后，他仍能在炎热的夏日下午修剪草坪，而且坚持亲自做。
sentences.paraphrase: Long after all his friends had died, he remained able and determined to cut the grass even on a hot summer afternoon.

classification.label: 并列复合句
classification.reason: 既有主句间的并列，又有内部或外部的限定从句。
classification.note: A generation 是 after 前的时距修饰。after 后有 died 的限定分句。doing so 指修剪草坪；insist on 后用 -ing。

clauses: A generation after the last of his friends died
he could still mow the lawn …
functions: A generation after the last of his friends died,
sentences.note: A generation 是 after 前的时距修饰。after 后有 died 的限定分句。doing so 指修剪草坪；insist on 后用 -ing。

reuse.pattern: Years after ___, ___ could still ___ and insisted on doing ___.
reuse.zh: 多年以后，虽然已经退休，他仍能修理钟表，并坚持亲手修理。
reuse.en: Years after he retired, he could still repair clocks and insisted on doing the work himself.

pdfNotes.title: remain / insist
pdfNotes.text: remain 后可接形容词作表语；remain to be done 是“仍有待完成”。insist on doing 指坚持做；insist that 若陈述事实用相应时态，若坚持要求才可能用 (should) do。

sentences.text: I usually wrestled the mower from his grip, but his extraordinary energy I took for granted.
sentences.translation: 我通常得从他手中抢过割草机，但对他惊人的精力，我却一直视为理所当然。
sentences.paraphrase: I generally struggled to take the mower away from him, yet I never questioned his remarkable energy.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: 第二主句是宾语前置：I took his extraordinary energy for granted。energy 不是主语；不能译出原文没有的“我夺不走他的精力”。

clauses: I usually wrestled the mower from his grip
his extraordinary energy I took for granted
sentences.note: 第二主句是宾语前置：I took his extraordinary energy for granted。energy 不是主语；不能译出原文没有的“我夺不走他的精力”。

reuse.pattern: I usually ___, but ___ I took for granted.
reuse.zh: 我常感谢她的建议，却把她的耐心视为理所当然。
reuse.en: I usually thanked her for her advice, but her patience I took for granted.
reuse.note: 后半句把宾语提前以突出对照，日常语序也可用 I took her patience for granted。

pdfNotes.title: 宾语前置并不增加新意思
pdfNotes.text: his extraordinary energy 是 took for granted 的前置宾语，与前面的 wrestled the mower 形成对照。“我夺不走他的精力”不是原文命题，不能放入准确改写。

sentences.text: I had seen it all my life; he was my roommate.
sentences.translation: 他一生如此，我早已习惯；他一直是我的室友。
sentences.paraphrase: His vitality had always been familiar to me, since we shared a room.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: 分号连接两个独立主句。it 指祖父的精力。过去完成时回望已持续很久的经历。

clauses: I had seen it all my life
sentences.note: 分号连接两个独立主句。it 指祖父的精力。过去完成时回望已持续很久的经历。

reuse.zh: 我以前见过她；她曾是我的老师。
reuse.en: I had met her before; she was my teacher.

sentences.text: At my birth he was 64, middle age to him, and he was not a gentle old soul.
sentences.translation: 我出生时他六十四岁——对他来说不过是中年——而且他并不是一位温和的老人。
sentences.paraphrase: He was 64 when I was born, an age he regarded as middle age, and he was far from a mild old man.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: middle age to him 补充说明“64 岁”意味着什么，没有独立谓语。soul 指人，不是字面“灵魂”。

clauses: he was not a gentle old soul
sentences.note: middle age to him 补充说明“64 岁”意味着什么，没有独立谓语。soul 指人，不是字面“灵魂”。

reuse.zh: 在我毕业时，他已七十岁，但他并不是个安静的退休老人。
reuse.en: At my graduation, he was seventy, and he was not a quiet retiree.

pdfNotes.title: 祖父的性格由行动呈现
pdfNotes.text: 64 岁竟只是他的“中年”，带亲昵的夸张；argued / screamed 与 lover of strife 连续铺写他好争论的一面。at a distance 指即使不亲临冲突现场也兴致勃勃。

sentences.text: He argued with the men in the synagogue, screamed at his fellows in the bakery where he worked until his mid-80s.
sentences.translation: 他在犹太会堂和人争辩，又在面包店朝同伴大嚷；他一直在那里工作到八十多岁。
sentences.paraphrase: He quarrelled with men at the synagogue and shouted at colleagues in the bakery, where he continued working into his mid-eighties.

pdfNotes.text: 重复 he 与连续的日常动词，让帮助体现为可见行动；不是长篇劝告。两处逗号连接独立分句是原文的累积节奏，正式仿写可用分号或连词保持清晰。

sentences.text: He never offered me advice or understanding, he just kept doing things.
sentences.translation: 他从未给我建议或表示理解，只是一直做着事情。
sentences.paraphrase: He gave me neither counsel nor expressions of understanding; he simply continued to act.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: 两个主句用逗号并置；offered me advice 为双宾语结构。keep doing 表持续，不用 keep to do。

clauses: He never offered me advice or understanding
sentences.note: 两个主句用逗号并置；offered me advice 为双宾语结构。keep doing 表持续，不用 keep to do。

reuse.zh: 他从不给长篇建议，只是不断地帮助我们。
reuse.en: He never offered long speeches of advice; he just kept helping us.

pdfNotes.title: 重复动作带来转变
pdfNotes.text: 重复 he 与连续的日常动词，让帮助体现为可见行动；不是长篇劝告。两处逗号连接独立分句是原文的累积节奏，正式仿写可用分号或连词保持清晰。

sentences.text: After about two years of melancholy, I joined him, started to see how much there was to do.
sentences.translation: 忧郁了约两年后，我也加入了他，开始看见原来有那么多事情要做。
sentences.paraphrase: After roughly two years of sadness, I began working alongside him and noticing all the things that needed doing.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: started 共用主语 I。how much 引出间接感叹／疑问性内容，much 指工作量；to do 修饰待做之事。

clauses: I joined him, started to see …
how much there was to do
functions: After about two years of melancholy,
how much there was to do.
sentences.note: started 共用主语 I。how much 引出间接感叹／疑问性内容，much 指工作量；to do 修饰待做之事。

reuse.pattern: After ___, I joined ___ and started to see how much ___.
reuse.zh: 几个月后，我加入了他们，开始看到还有多少工作要做。
reuse.en: After a few months, I joined them and started to see how much work remained.

pdfNotes.title: 重复动作带来转变
pdfNotes.text: 重复 he 与连续的日常动词，让帮助体现为可见行动；不是长篇劝告。两处逗号连接独立分句是原文的累积节奏，正式仿写可用分号或连词保持清晰。

sentences.text: Now I get up early and I stay busy.
sentences.translation: 现在，我早早起床，让自己保持忙碌。
sentences.paraphrase: These days, I rise early and keep myself occupied.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: 两边都写出 I，按既定标准归并列句。stay busy 中 stay 为系动词，不是“停留在忙”。

sentences.note: 两边都写出 I，按既定标准归并列句。stay busy 中 stay 为系动词，不是“停留在忙”。

reuse.zh: 现在我每天散步，也保持忙碌。
reuse.en: Now I walk every day and I stay busy.

pdfNotes.title: 导图中的时间线
pdfNotes.text: 童年同住 → 求学时再度同住 → 成家后遭遇危机 → 跟随祖父重新投入日常生活。叙述重点是“我”对祖父与自己的理解如何变化，末段回应开头的成长主题。

pdfNotes.title: 结尾的呼应
pdfNotes.text: 起早、保持忙碌、倒垃圾和割草，显示“我”继承了祖父的生活方式；梦话再次呼应童年同住。one a century 带亲昵的夸张与稀有感，不是客观统计频率。

sentences.text: There's a lot of garbage to take out and in Texas there's always a lawn to mow.
sentences.translation: 总有许多垃圾要倒，而在得克萨斯，总有草坪要修。
sentences.paraphrase: There is plenty of rubbish to put out, and a Texas lawn always needs cutting.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: 两个 there be 结构并列。to take out / to mow 的动作由人执行，被修饰名词与动词有宾语关系；不定式用主动形式，意为待处理的事。

clauses: There's a lot of garbage to take out
in Texas there's always a lawn to mow
sentences.note: 两个 there be 结构并列。to take out / to mow 的动作由人执行，被修饰名词与动词有宾语关系；不定式用主动形式，意为待处理的事。

reuse.pattern: There is ___ to do, and there is ___ to do.
reuse.zh: 还有报告要写，也还有一场会议要准备。
reuse.en: There is a report to write, and there is a meeting to prepare for.
reuse.note: 不定式与名词有被动语义关系，仍可用主动形式。

pdfNotes.title: 结尾的呼应
pdfNotes.text: 起早、保持忙碌、倒垃圾和割草，显示“我”继承了祖父的生活方式；梦话再次呼应童年同住。one a century 带亲昵的夸张与稀有感，不是客观统计频率。

sentences.text: I don't talk in my sleep yet, but even if I start, nobody will hear me.
sentences.translation: 我还不会说梦话，但即使开始了，也不会有人听见。
sentences.paraphrase: I have not begun talking in my sleep, but if I do, there will be no one there to listen.

classification.label: 并列复合句
classification.reason: 既有主句间的并列，又有内部或外部的限定从句。
classification.note: even if 表假设“即使”，不表示已经开始。start 后省略 talking in my sleep；nobody 暗示祖父已不在，照应室友主题。

clauses: I don't talk in my sleep yet
sentences.note: even if 表假设“即使”，不表示已经开始。start 后省略 talking in my sleep；nobody 暗示祖父已不在，照应室友主题。

reuse.pattern: I don't ___ yet, but even if I ___, ___.
reuse.zh: 我现在还不开车，但即使以后开始开车，我仍会坐火车去上班。
reuse.en: I don't drive yet, but even if I start, I will still take the train to work.

pdfNotes.title: 结尾的呼应
pdfNotes.text: 起早、保持忙碌、倒垃圾和割草，显示“我”继承了祖父的生活方式；梦话再次呼应童年同住。one a century 带亲昵的夸张与稀有感，不是客观统计频率。

sentences.text: Roommates like him only come along about one a century.
sentences.translation: 像他这样的室友，大概一个世纪才会出现一位。
sentences.paraphrase: A person like him is an exceptionally rare roommate, appearing perhaps once in a hundred years.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: like him 修饰 Roommates；about one a century 是压缩的频率说法，近于 at a rate of about one per century。以夸张表达珍爱，并非统计结论。

clauses: Roommates like him only come along about one a century.
sentences.note: like him 修饰 Roommates；about one a century 是压缩的频率说法，近于 at a rate of about one per century。以夸张表达珍爱，并非统计结论。

reuse.zh: 像她这样的老师一生难得遇到一次。
reuse.en: Teachers like her come along only once in a lifetime.
reuse.note: 原句 one a century 是亲昵的夸张；once in a lifetime 也突出难得。

pdfNotes.title: 导图中的时间线
pdfNotes.text: 童年同住 → 求学时再度同住 → 成家后遭遇危机 → 跟随祖父重新投入日常生活。叙述重点是“我”对祖父与自己的理解如何变化，末段回应开头的成长主题。

pdfNotes.title: 结尾的呼应
pdfNotes.text: 起早、保持忙碌、倒垃圾和割草，显示“我”继承了祖父的生活方式；梦话再次呼应童年同住。one a century 带亲昵的夸张与稀有感，不是客观统计频率。

vocabulary.definition: in comparison with, or in one's relationship with — 相对于；在与……的关系中
collocations: in relation to my grandfather 相对于祖父
in relation to age 就年龄而言
compare: in relation to：表示关系或比较的参照
vocabulary.usage: 本文强调“在我与祖父的关系中，我仍是孩子”，不宜改写成只描述祖父眼中的我。
otherSenses: concerning or connected with — 关于、与……有关

vocabulary.definition: cut grass with a blade or machine — 割草；修剪草坪
collocations: mow the lawn 修剪草坪
mow the grass 割草
compare: mow：割草或作物，常为维护草坪
vocabulary.usage: 过去式 mowed；过去分词 mown 或 mowed。不是所有 cut 都能换成 mow。
otherSenses: mow somebody down — 撞倒或大量射杀
是完整短语的引申义，不是 mow 单独的常用义

vocabulary.definition: an area of short, maintained grass — 草坪
collocations: mow the lawn 修剪草坪
a front lawn 门前草坪
vocabulary.usage: 一片草坪可说 a lawn；“草”本身通常是不可数 grass。

vocabulary.definition: a machine for cutting grass — 割草机
collocations: a lawn mower 草坪割草机
a petrol mower 汽油割草机
vocabulary.usage: mower 与 mow 有派生关系。本文 wrestled the mower from his grip 指费力地从他手中接过机器。

vocabulary.definition: a firm hold on something — 紧握；抓牢
collocations: a firm grip 紧紧抓握
loosen one's grip 松手
grip the handle 握住把手
vocabulary.usage: 本文 from his grip 是“从他紧握的手中”，不是单指抽象握力。动词变化 gripped、gripping。
otherSenses: n. control or understanding — 控制、掌握，如 a grip on reality
v. hold tightly — 紧抓
v. attract strong attention — 紧紧吸引

vocabulary.definition: assume something will always be available and undervalue it — 视为理所当然；不懂珍惜
collocations: take someone for granted 不重视某人的付出
take it for granted that… 想当然地认为……
compare: take for granted：未经反思地默认，常缺少珍惜
vocabulary.usage: 本文 his extraordinary energy 是提前的宾语；还原为 I took his extraordinary energy for granted。
otherSenses: assume something is true without checking — 想当然地认为……属实，常用 take it for granted that…

vocabulary.definition: a building for Jewish worship and community life — 犹太会堂
collocations: go to synagogue 去犹太会堂
a local synagogue 当地犹太会堂
vocabulary.usage: 不能泛译成“教堂”而丢失祖父的犹太文化背景。此类名词不必硬凑派生词。

vocabulary.definition: serious conflict or bitter disagreement — 冲突；纷争
collocations: civil strife 内乱
industrial strife 劳资纷争
compare: strife：持续、激烈的不和，较正式
vocabulary.usage: 通常不可数。本文 a lover of strife 是带幽默的性格刻画；即便不亲身参与，他也关注争斗。

vocabulary.definition: by free choice, without being forced — 自愿地；主动地
collocations: leave voluntarily 自愿离开
voluntarily offer help 主动提供帮助
compare: spontaneously：未经预先安排而自然发生。
vocabulary.usage: 自愿不等于没有压力，也不必然表示无偿。本文指孩子主动承担教祖父知识的角色。

vocabulary.definition: a country on the Baltic Sea — 立陶宛
collocations: from Lithuania 来自立陶宛
Lithuanian culture 立陶宛文化
compare: Lithuanian：该国的／该国人／立陶宛语
family: Lithuanian n. 立陶宛人或语
vocabulary.usage: 国家名通常不加 the；首字母大写。祖父来自此地，不等于他的母语必然是立陶宛语。

vocabulary.definition: a person sent to represent someone or deliver a message — 使者；特使
collocations: a personal emissary 私人特使
send an emissary 派遣使者
vocabulary.usage: 正式用词，不必然秘密或级别低。本文把小学生自比知识使者，有自嘲意味。

vocabulary.definition: basic; relating to the first stage of education — 基础的；小学的
collocations: elementary school 小学
elementary knowledge 基础知识
vocabulary.usage: elementary school 是美式常用名称。与学校阶段有关时，不译成“简单学校”。
otherSenses: adj. very simple and easy — 最基本的、简单的

vocabulary.definition: give someone facts or information — 告知；向……介绍
collocations: inform someone about/of something 告知某人某事
inform someone that… 告知……
compare: notify：正式通知某个事实或安排。
family: informative adj. 提供有用信息的
vocabulary.usage: 通常须有人的宾语：inform him about…。information 不可数，不说 an information。
otherSenses: shape or influence an opinion or decision — 影响、塑造（正式），如 research informs policy

vocabulary.definition: not obvious and requiring careful understanding — 微妙的；不易理解的
collocations: a subtle difference 细微差异
subtle humour 含蓄的幽默
vocabulary.usage: b 不发音。本文 subtle things like electricity 带孩子自认为掌握深奥知识的口吻。
otherSenses: adj. slight and hard to notice — 细微的、不明显的
adj. skilful and indirect — 巧妙含蓄的

vocabulary.definition: a high sound made through a small opening — 哨声；口哨
collocations: a low whistle 低低的口哨声
whistle a tune 吹一段曲调
vocabulary.usage: t 不发音。本文用哨声比喻祖父一种鼾声，不是祖父清醒地吹口哨。
otherSenses: n. a small device that makes a high sound — 哨子
v. make a high sound with the lips — 吹口哨
v. move with a whistling sound — 呼啸而过

vocabulary.definition: a short burst of air, smoke or breath — 一股气；一阵呼气
collocations: a puff of breath 一口呼气
puffs of smoke 一股股烟
vocabulary.usage: 本文 a great puff 指鼾声末尾较强的一次呼气。a puff of 后可接不可数物质名词。
otherSenses: n. a draw on a cigarette — 吸一口烟
v. breathe hard — 气喘吁吁
puff up — 膨起、肿起

vocabulary.definition: an offensive expression or a wish for harm — 咒骂；诅咒
collocations: curse words 脏话
put a curse on someone 诅咒某人
vocabulary.usage: curse words 通常指粗俗骂人话；后文关于疾病的愿景又呈现了诅咒义。不可只保留“魔咒”。
otherSenses: n. a continuing source of trouble — 祸根、灾祸
v. use offensive words — 咒骂

vocabulary.definition: a language historically used by many European Jews — 意第绪语；意第绪语的
collocations: speak Yiddish 说意第绪语
Yiddish literature 意第绪语文学
compare: Yiddish：日耳曼语族的犹太语言
Hebrew：希伯来语，是另一种语言
vocabulary.usage: 语言名大写，通常不用冠词。不能与 Hebrew 混为一谈，也不能把 Jewish 当语言名。

vocabulary.definition: soften an impact or provide soft support — 缓冲；柔软地承托
collocations: cushion the impact 缓和冲击
cushion someone against a loss 减轻某人的损失
compare: cushion：像软垫一样缓冲或承托
vocabulary.usage: 本文 Cushioned by… 是过去分词，描绘毁灭意象被呼气声托载或包裹，属于文学隐喻。不是名词“垫子”。
otherSenses: n. a soft support for sitting — 靠垫、坐垫
n. protection against loss or difficulty — 起缓冲作用的保障，如 a financial cushion

vocabulary.definition: a painful infected swelling — 疖；脓肿
collocations: a painful boil 疼痛的疖
develop boils 长疖子
family: boil v. 煮沸（另一义项）
vocabulary.usage: 本文 Boils 是主语名词，sprouted 才是谓语；不要译为“肠子沸腾”。此处是梦中的诅咒意象。
otherSenses: v. heat a liquid until it bubbles — 煮沸
v. cook in boiling water — 水煮
boil with anger — 怒火中烧

vocabulary.definition: begin to grow or appear — 萌发；长出
collocations: seeds sprout 种子发芽
sprout leaves 长出叶子
vocabulary.usage: 本文把疾病写成植物般“长出”，为不及物 sprout on…；不是说祖父真在栽种。
otherSenses: n. a new plant shoot — 新芽、嫩芽
sprouts — 芽菜

vocabulary.definition: the tube through which food passes after the stomach — 肠
collocations: the small intestine 小肠
the large intestine 大肠
compare: gut：较口语的肠胃，也指直觉。
vocabulary.usage: 通常用复数 intestines 泛指肠道；特指小肠或大肠时可用单数。

vocabulary.definition: a serious infectious disease of the digestive system — 霍乱
collocations: a cholera outbreak 霍乱暴发
cholera cases 霍乱病例
vocabulary.usage: 病名一般不可数。本文写祖父梦中敌人遭灾的意象，不是作者报告真实疫情。

vocabulary.definition: greatly reduce the population of a place — 使人口锐减；使居民减少
collocations: depopulate a village 使村庄人口锐减
rural depopulation 农村人口减少
compare: devastate：造成严重破坏，不专指人口。
vocabulary.usage: 及物，宾语是地点。depopulate 不必然意味着所有人死亡；本文是夸张的梦境叙述。

vocabulary.definition: crackling noise interfering with a radio signal — 静电干扰声；收音机杂音
collocations: radio static 收音机杂音
hear static 听到干扰声
family: static adj. 静止的（另一义项）
vocabulary.usage: 本文是名词，不能译为“静止的”。它比喻孩子把祖父的怒气听成背景杂音。
otherSenses: adj. not moving or changing — 静止的、不变的
n. static electricity — 静电

vocabulary.definition: made up of short, separate sounds — 断续急促的；以断奏方式
collocations: staccato speech 短促断续的话音
a staccato rhythm 断奏节奏
compare: abrupt：突然或生硬，不必然反复。
family: staccato adj. / adv. 断续的／断奏地
vocabulary.usage: 本是音乐术语，也可描写说话和噪声。本文把咒骂重听成音乐，呼应怀念的情绪。

vocabulary.definition: a sudden strong expression of emotion — 情绪爆发；突然迸发的话语
collocations: an outburst of anger 怒气爆发
an emotional outburst 情绪宣泄
compare: rant：持续且激烈的抱怨长谈。
vocabulary.usage: 常接 of + 情绪。不是所有 burst 都是 outburst，也不能把此名词直接当动词。
otherSenses: n. a sudden strong activity or sound — 突然爆发的活动或声响，如 an outburst of applause

vocabulary.definition: live in a place — 居住于；栖居于
collocations: inhabit an area 居住在某地区
a densely inhabited district 人口稠密区
compare: inhabit：直接以地点作宾语，较正式
vocabulary.usage: 直接说 inhabit the community，不再加 in。原文定语从句省略的关系词作 inhabited 的宾语。

vocabulary.definition: without being prevented by something — 尽管；不顾
collocations: in spite of the age gap 尽管年龄有差距
in spite of being tired 尽管疲倦
family: 固定短语：in spite of 尽管
vocabulary.usage: 三个词；despite 后不加 of。接完整从句时可说 in spite of the fact that…。

vocabulary.definition: pleasant to be with because of compatible qualities — 合得来的；意气相投的
collocations: a congenial companion 合得来的伙伴
congenial company 令人愉快的陪伴
compare: compatible：性质或生活方式能相容。
vocabulary.usage: 本文不是说“同龄”，恰恰强调年龄悬殊仍合得来。较正式，常修饰 companion/company。
otherSenses: adj. pleasant and well suited to one's needs — 适意的、适合的，如 congenial surroundings

vocabulary.definition: a person or group supporting the same cause — 盟友；支持者
collocations: a close ally 亲密盟友
political allies 政治盟友
compare: ally：目标或立场上的合作伙伴
vocabulary.usage: 名词常读 /ˈælaɪ/；动词常读 /əˈlaɪ/。本文指讨厌共和党这一立场上的同道，不是军事同盟。
otherSenses: v. join forces with somebody — 与……结盟，动词重音常在后：/əˈlaɪ/
名词通常 /ˈælaɪ/

vocabulary.definition: in terms of political or social beliefs — 在思想观念上；从意识形态上说
collocations: ideologically opposed 思想上对立的
ideologically compatible 观念相容的
compare: ideologically：关注整套政治社会信念
politically：关注政治立场、权力或活动
vocabulary.usage: 句首副词限定评价角度，并非修饰某一个具体动作。本文含幽默：祖父能同时从战争与反战中找到争论。

vocabulary.definition: coming before and preparing for a later stage — 初步的；预备的
collocations: preliminary exams 资格／预备考试
preliminary findings 初步发现
vocabulary.usage: Ph.D. preliminary exams 在本文为博士阶段的资格考试；并不意味着题目简单。
otherSenses: n. an introductory step or event — 预备步骤
preliminaries — 预赛、初步活动

vocabulary.definition: sleep lightly for a short time — 打盹；小睡
collocations: doze off 不知不觉睡着
have a doze 打个盹
compare: nap：短时间睡眠，可有意安排
vocabulary.usage: doze off 强调渐渐进入睡眠，本文是读书时打盹，不是熟睡一整夜。
otherSenses: n. a short light sleep — 瞌睡、小睡

vocabulary.definition: in a way that makes fun of someone — 嘲弄地；揶揄地
collocations: smile mockingly 嘲弄地笑
repeat mockingly 模仿着取笑
vocabulary.usage: 本文修饰 mark：祖父模仿划重点来取笑孙子的“工作”，不是说报纸本身有嘲讽内容。

vocabulary.definition: copy someone's actions, voice or style — 模仿
collocations: imitate someone's voice 模仿嗓音
imitate an action 模仿动作
compare: mock：以取笑为目的，不一定模仿。
vocabulary.usage: 直接接对象。本文 to imitate 表目的；what I was doing 整体作 imitate 的宾语。
otherSenses: make a copy of a material or appearance — 仿制、仿造

vocabulary.definition: a contrast between what is expected and what happens — 出人意料的反差；命运的讽刺
collocations: the irony of the situation 处境的讽刺
an ironic twist 出人意料的转折
compare: irony：预期与现实相反，或字面与本意相反
family: ironic adj. 出乎意料的／反讽的
vocabulary.usage: 本文是情境反讽：本想照顾祖父，反而成了需要帮助的人。不是祖父说反话。
otherSenses: n. saying the opposite of one's intended meaning — 反语
不能把所有意外都称为 irony，通常要有预期与结果的意味深长的反差

vocabulary.definition: break or develop a split; fail under strain — 破裂；崩溃
collocations: crack under pressure 压力下崩溃
a crack in the wall 墙缝
compare: crack：出现裂痕或开始失去完整
vocabulary.usage: 本文 life cracked 为隐喻：原本稳固的生活因疾病而崩裂，不是物理裂纹。
otherSenses: n. a narrow split — 裂缝
v. solve something difficult — 破解
crack a joke — 讲笑话
crack down on — 严厉打击（短语）

vocabulary.definition: severely affected by illness or suffering — 遭受疾病或灾难侵袭的
collocations: be stricken with disease 患重病
grief-stricken 悲痛欲绝的
compare: affected：受到影响，程度未必严重。
vocabulary.usage: stricken 常见于疾病、悲痛或灾难语境；普通 strike 的过去式和过去分词通常为 struck，不能一律用 stricken。
otherSenses: adj. overwhelmed by a strong feeling — 深受打击的，如 grief-stricken 悲痛欲绝的

vocabulary.definition: relating to the nervous system or neurology — 神经系统的；神经科的
collocations: a neurologic disease 神经系统疾病
neurological symptoms 神经系统症状
compare: nervous：可指神经系统，也常指紧张
vocabulary.usage: neurologic 与 neurological 意义基本相同。不要误译成“紧张的疾病”或据此猜测具体诊断。

vocabulary.definition: wonderful or worthy of admiration — 美好的；令人赞叹的
collocations: a glorious day 美好的一天
a glorious achievement 辉煌成就
vocabulary.usage: 本文 anything glorious 指能使自己振奋、觉得值得划线的内容；“光荣的文字”会显得生硬。
otherSenses: adj. bringing honour or fame — 光荣的
adj. exceptionally pleasant — 极好的，如 glorious weather

vocabulary.definition: draw a line under words; emphasize — 在文字下划线；强调
collocations: underline a passage 给段落划线
underline the importance 强调重要性
compare: highlight：用颜色突出，也指特别指出
vocabulary.usage: 本文为实际读书动作。anything glorious to underline 中 to underline 后的宾语位置由 anything 对应。

vocabulary.definition: a garment worn under a shirt — 贴身汗衫；内衣背心
collocations: wear an undershirt 穿汗衫
a cotton undershirt 棉质汗衫
vocabulary.usage: as an undershirt 是死亡如贴身内衣的比喻，强调死亡已贴近祖父，不是他真的穿了某种“死亡衣服”。

vocabulary.definition: a distinctive, usually pleasant smell — 芳香；香气
collocations: the aroma of coffee 咖啡香
a rich aroma 浓郁香气
vocabulary.usage: 本文 the aroma of life 为通感式隐喻，指生命的吸引力，不是真有一种固定气味。

vocabulary.definition: one of the two openings of the nose — 鼻孔
collocations: flared nostrils 张大的鼻孔
breathe through the nostrils 用鼻孔呼吸
vocabulary.usage: 常用复数指两侧鼻孔。本文与 aroma 配合，使“热爱生活”成为具体的嗅觉画面。

vocabulary.definition: a lingering feeling of sadness — 忧郁；忧郁的
collocations: a sense of melancholy 忧郁感
a melancholy mood 忧郁的心境
compare: melancholy：持续的忧伤，常带文学色彩
depression：可指低落，也有临床专义。
vocabulary.usage: 本文是 after about two years of melancholy，名词。不能仅凭这个词作医学诊断。

vocabulary.definition: appear or become available — 出现；来到
collocations: an opportunity comes along 机会出现
someone like him comes along 像他这样的人出现
compare: come along：在时间进程中出现
vocabulary.usage: 本文“一百年才遇到一个这样的室友”是夸张的赞叹。不是催促 Come along!，也不是“跟随”。
otherSenses: accompany someone — 一同前往
make progress — 进展
Come along! — 快点、来吧（语气取决于场景）

sentences.text: Rush hour in a provincial town is certainly not so busy as in London, but even so there are plenty of people moving about.
sentences.translation: 地方城镇的高峰时段当然不像伦敦那么繁忙，但即便如此，仍有许多人来来往往。
sentences.paraphrase: Although this town's rush hour is quieter than London's, many people are still on the move.

classification.label: 并列句
classification.reason: 两个或以上并列主句，包括省略重复谓语的并列分句。
classification.note: as in London 是压缩的比较补充，未写出限定分句。moving about 为分词后置修饰 people，不是谓语。

clauses: Rush hour … is certainly not so busy as in London
there are plenty of people moving about
functions: Rush hour in a provincial town
sentences.note: as in London 是压缩的比较补充，未写出限定分句。moving about 为分词后置修饰 people，不是谓语。

reuse.pattern: ___ is not so ___ as ___, but even so there are ___ doing ___.
reuse.zh: 小镇没有大城市那么忙碌，但即便如此，仍有许多人四处走动。
reuse.en: The town is not so busy as the city, but even so there are many people moving about.

pdfNotes.title: 导图：观察、想象、揭晓
pdfNotes.text: 前两段建立通勤场景；中段展示 Matti 从外表编造的身份与生活；后段以豪车和 Geoffrey 的介绍揭晓事实。导图写 billionaire 不准确：原文是约两百万英镑，应称百万富翁／富有的实业家。

pdfNotes.title: provincial 的两层意思
pdfNotes.text: 本文 provincial town 指首都以外的地方城镇；provincial 也可贬指眼界狭窄。rural 指乡村的，不等于 provincial；地方城镇同样可以是城市环境。

sentences.text: Long, patient queues wait wearily for buses.
sentences.translation: 耐心等候的人们排成长队，疲倦地等着公共汽车。
sentences.paraphrase: People stand patiently in long queues, tired of waiting for their buses.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: queues 代指排队的人，才可承受 patient、wearily 的人的特征；属于转喻。for buses 不是目的不定式。

clauses: Long, patient queues wait wearily for buses.
sentences.note: queues 代指排队的人，才可承受 patient、wearily 的人的特征；属于转喻。for buses 不是目的不定式。

reuse.zh: 疲惫的旅客静静地等待列车。
reuse.en: Tired passengers wait quietly for the train.

pdfNotes.title: queues 与头韵
pdfNotes.text: queues 代表排队的人，patient / wearily 把人的状态移到队伍上；可以讨论移就和拟人色彩，不必把队伍当成字面上的人。wait wearily 重复 /w/，营造拖沓疲惫的节奏。

sentences.text: Never-ending lines of cars are checked while red traffic lights change to green.
sentences.translation: 一眼望不到头的车流停下来，等着红灯转绿。
sentences.paraphrase: Seemingly endless streams of cars are held up, waiting for traffic lights to turn green.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: checked 在此是“被阻止前进”，不是检查车辆。while 描写等待灯色转换的时段；原文不改成另一连词。

clauses: Never-ending lines of cars are checked
while red traffic lights change to green
functions: while red traffic lights change to green.
sentences.note: checked 在此是“被阻止前进”，不是检查车辆。while 描写等待灯色转换的时段；原文不改成另一连词。

reuse.zh: 当信号从红色变为绿色时，车辆仍被拦住。
reuse.en: Cars are held back while the signal changes from red to green.

pdfNotes.title: check 在此不是检查证件
pdfNotes.text: are checked 指车流被阻住、行进受限制。句子提到信号灯，未明确写交警，因此释义不擅自增加“交警检查”。

sentences.text: Thousands of people are packed tightly in trains, the men's faces buried in their evening papers while women try in vain to knit.
sentences.translation: 成千上万的人紧挤在火车里，男人埋头读晚报，女人则徒劳地试着织毛线。
sentences.paraphrase: The crowded trains carry men absorbed in newspapers and women unsuccessfully trying to knit.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: faces 是 buried 的逻辑主语；独立主格没有限定谓语，不能把 buried 当过去式。while 引出的从句另有主语 women 与限定谓语 try。

clauses: Thousands of people are packed tightly in trains
the men's faces buried in their evening papers
while women try in vain to knit
functions: the men's faces buried in their evening papers
while women try in vain to knit.
sentences.note: faces 是 buried 的逻辑主语；独立主格没有限定谓语，不能把 buried 当过去式。while 引出的从句另有主语 women 与限定谓语 try。

reuse.zh: 孩子们坐在教室里，手指轻敲桌面，而老师正在写字。
reuse.en: The children are sitting in the classroom, their fingers tapping the desks while the teacher writes.
reuse.note: their fingers tapping…是独立主格，while 引出有限从句。

pdfNotes.title: 独立主格与 while
pdfNotes.text: the men's faces buried… 有自己的逻辑主语，补充车厢中的伴随画面；可用 with…改写，但原文没有 with，不必假定是机械删除。while women… 与男人读报的画面同时发生，也带对照。

pdfNotes.title: bury one's head 的对象决定意思
pdfNotes.text: bury one's head in a newspaper 指埋头读报；表示逃避问题的典型习语是 bury one's head in the sand。不能把任何 bury one's head in… 都解释成“逃避现实”。

sentences.text: In a slow train it may well be an hour's journey to their station.
sentences.translation: 坐慢车到他们的车站，很可能得花一小时。
sentences.paraphrase: Travelling to their station on a slow train could easily take an hour.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: may well 表很可能，不是“也许很好”。it 泛指这趟旅程；an hour's journey 用所有格表示历时。

clauses: it may well be an hour's journey to their station.
functions: an hour's journey to their station.
sentences.note: may well 表很可能，不是“也许很好”。it 泛指这趟旅程；an hour's journey 用所有格表示历时。

reuse.zh: 走到车站很可能需要一小时。
reuse.en: It may well be an hour's walk to the station.

pdfNotes.title: may well 与 might as well
pdfNotes.text: may well be 在这里表示很有可能；might as well do 表示既然如此不妨做。一个判断可能性，一个提出选择，不能混用。

sentences.text: James Saxon is in his usual comfortable corner, quietly smoking a cigarette.
sentences.translation: 詹姆斯·萨克森坐在惯常那个舒适的角落里，静静地抽着一支烟。
sentences.paraphrase: James Saxon sits in his familiar, comfortable corner and smokes quietly.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: smoking 的逻辑主语是 James Saxon，表示伴随动作；is 与 smoking 被完整地点结构隔开，不能简单拼成同一个进行时谓语。

clauses: James Saxon is in his usual comfortable corner
sentences.note: smoking 的逻辑主语是 James Saxon，表示伴随动作；is 与 smoking 被完整地点结构隔开，不能简单拼成同一个进行时谓语。

reuse.zh: 她坐在平常那个角落，安静地读书。
reuse.en: She is in her usual corner, quietly reading a book.

sentences.text: When he is travelling by train at this time, he always reaches the station at ten past five by the station clock, but he never catches the 5:14 train.
sentences.translation: 每当这时乘火车出行，他总按车站时钟在五点十分到站，却从不乘五点十四分那班车。
sentences.paraphrase: On these journeys he always arrives at 5:10 according to the station clock, yet he never takes the 5:14 departure.

classification.label: 并列复合句
classification.reason: 既有主句间的并列，又有内部或外部的限定从句。
classification.note: by the station clock 意为以车站时钟为准。but 连接两个主句；when 从句作习惯性出行的时间背景。

clauses: When he is travelling by train at this time
functions: When he is travelling by train at this time,
sentences.note: by the station clock 意为以车站时钟为准。but 连接两个主句；when 从句作习惯性出行的时间背景。

reuse.zh: 他坐火车旅行时总会早到，但他从不买头等座。
reuse.en: When he travels by train, he always arrives early, but he never buys a first-class ticket.

pdfNotes.title: 读钟表与列车时间
pdfNotes.text: ten past five = 5:10；twenty-four minutes past five = 5:24；a quarter past six = 6:15。整点用 o'clock；past 表已过本小时，to 表离下一整点还差多少分钟。5:24 也可读 five twenty-four。

sentences.text: Instead he travels by the train which leaves at twenty-four minutes past five so as to be sure of getting his corner seat.
sentences.translation: 他改乘五点二十四分开出的那班车，以确保坐到角落座位。
sentences.paraphrase: He chooses the 5:24 train instead, ensuring that he can get his preferred corner seat.

classification.label: 主从复合句
classification.reason: 主句包含或附带限定从句；先找主句骨架，再逐层识别从属关系。
classification.note: which 指 train，作 leaves 主语。so as to 表目的，不是 so that 从句。be sure of 后接 getting。

clauses: which leaves at twenty-four minutes past five
so as to be sure of getting his corner seat
functions: which leaves at twenty-four minutes past five
so as to be sure of getting his corner seat.
sentences.note: which 指 train，作 leaves 主语。so as to 表目的，不是 so that 从句。be sure of 后接 getting。

reuse.pattern: ___ travels by the ___ which ___ so as to ___.
reuse.zh: 她乘坐六点发车的巴士，以便能按时到达。
reuse.en: She travels by the bus which leaves at six so as to arrive on time.

pdfNotes.title: 读钟表与列车时间
pdfNotes.text: ten past five = 5:10；twenty-four minutes past five = 5:24；a quarter past six = 6:15。整点用 o'clock；past 表已过本小时，to 表离下一整点还差多少分钟。5:24 也可读 five twenty-four。

pdfNotes.title: 目的结构的逻辑主语
pdfNotes.text: so as to be sure… 说明 James 选择这趟车的目的，不是说火车要确保座位。so as not to 是否定形式；改成 so that 后需完整主语和谓语。

sentences.text: There are no first-class compartments or reserved seats on this train.
sentences.translation: 这班列车既没有一等隔间，也不设预订座位。
sentences.paraphrase: This train has neither first-class sections nor seats that passengers can book in advance.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: no 的否定范围覆盖 or 连接的两项。reserved 为过去分词定语，不是句子的独立谓语。

clauses: There are no first-class compartments or reserved seats on this train.
functions: no first-class compartments or reserved seats
sentences.note: no 的否定范围覆盖 or 连接的两项。reserved 为过去分词定语，不是句子的独立谓语。

reuse.zh: 这趟车上没有餐食，也没有预留座位。
reuse.en: There are no meals or reserved seats on this train.

pdfNotes.title: reserved / absorbed
pdfNotes.text: reserved seats 是预留座位，reserved 描写人则是拘谨、不轻易流露感情。absorbed / engrossed in 强调专注；preoccupied with 常指心思被占据，obsessed with 常带过度执着，不能都无差别互换。

sentences.text: He appears to be absorbed in the sports news on the back page of his paper and ignores the hurrying crowds.
sentences.translation: 他看上去全神贯注于报纸背面的体育新闻，对匆忙的人群毫不理会。
sentences.paraphrase: He seems engrossed in the sports page and pays no attention to the people rushing around him.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: appears 和 ignores 共用主语。to be absorbed 是不定式，不是限定从句；appears 提醒读者这只是外部观察。

clauses: to be absorbed in the sports news …
functions: to be absorbed in the sports news on the back page of his paper
sentences.note: appears 和 ignores 共用主语。to be absorbed 是不定式，不是限定从句；appears 提醒读者这只是外部观察。

reuse.pattern: ___ appears to be absorbed in ___ and ignores ___.
reuse.zh: 他似乎专注于书本，无视周围的噪声。
reuse.en: He appears to be absorbed in his book and ignores the noise around him.

pdfNotes.title: reserved / absorbed
pdfNotes.text: reserved seats 是预留座位，reserved 描写人则是拘谨、不轻易流露感情。absorbed / engrossed in 强调专注；preoccupied with 常指心思被占据，obsessed with 常带过度执着，不能都无差别互换。

sentences.text: Facing him this evening there is a Finnish youth of eighteen, Matti Arpola.
sentences.translation: 今晚，坐在他对面的是十八岁的芬兰青年马蒂·阿尔波拉。
sentences.paraphrase: Seated opposite him tonight is Matti Arpola, an eighteen-year-old from Finland.

classification.label: 简单句
classification.reason: 一个限定主句；共用主语的并列谓语按一个主句处理，非谓语及省略结构另作提示。
classification.note: Facing him 描写位置，逻辑上对应后面的 youth；不宜按通常悬垂分词规则误说 there 在面对他。Matti Arpola 为同位语。

clauses: there is a Finnish youth of eighteen, Matti Arpola
sentences.note: Facing him 描写位置，逻辑上对应后面的 youth；不宜按通常悬垂分词规则误说 there 在面对他。Matti Arpola 为同位语。

reuse.zh: 面对着我的是一位年轻音乐家，我的邻居安娜。
reuse.en: Facing me there is a young musician, my neighbour Anna.
reuse.note: 后面的名词短语是同位说明。

pdfNotes.title: Finn 与 Finnish
pdfNotes.text: a Finn / Finns 指芬兰人；Finnish 作形容词表示芬兰的，也作名词指芬兰语。讲义的地图帮助定位北欧；对国民性格的泛化不当作每个人的事实。

sentences.text: This is his first visit to England, though he already knows Geoffrey, the eldest son of the Jackson family, with whom he is going to stay.
sentences.translation: 这是他第一次到英国，不过他早已认识杰克逊家长子杰弗里，并准备住在他们家。

vocabulary.definition: the period when many people travel to or from work — 交通高峰时段
collocations: during rush hour 在高峰时段
rush-hour traffic 高峰车流
compare: rush hour：通勤带来的拥挤时段
peak hours：任何需求最高的时段
vocabulary.usage: 作名词用 rush hour；放另一名词前常加连字符，如 rush-hour traffic。并不一定恰好持续一小时。

vocabulary.definition: belonging to places outside the capital or main cities — 外省的；地方的
collocations: a provincial town 地方城镇
provincial government 省级政府
compare: provincial：相对首都或大城市的地方
vocabulary.usage: 本文是地理位置义，不要机械译成“狭隘落后的城镇”。provincial 形容态度时才可能含贬义。
otherSenses: adj. limited in outlook — 眼界狭窄的、土气的（贬义）

vocabulary.definition: a line of people waiting their turn — 队列；排队
collocations: join a queue 加入队伍
queue for a bus 排队等车
vocabulary.usage: 字母虽多，读音仅 /kjuː/，与 cue 同音。排队用 queue for，不说 queue a bus。
otherSenses: n. a sequence of tasks waiting to be processed — 等候处理的任务队列
v. wait in a line — 排队

vocabulary.definition: fill a place tightly with people or things — 挤满；塞满
collocations: be packed with people 挤满人
pack into a train 挤进火车
vocabulary.usage: 本文 are packed 为被动；in trains 表地点。不是“乘客被包装”，也不同于 pack a suitcase 收拾行李。
otherSenses: v. put things in a bag or case — 打包、装箱
n. a group or wrapped quantity — 一包、一组
n. a group of animals — 一群动物，如 a pack of wolves

vocabulary.definition: hide or lower one's face into something — 把脸埋进；埋头于
collocations: bury one's face in a pillow 把脸埋进枕头
bury one's head in a book 埋头读书
compare: bury one's head：头深埋其中、专注或藏起
vocabulary.usage: bury 读 /ˈberi/，不是 /ˈbʌri/。原句 faces buried in papers 是独立主格中的过去分词；词卡保留词表的基本结构。
otherSenses: bury one's head in the sand — 逃避现实
in the sand 是这个习语的重要组成部分

vocabulary.definition: without achieving the desired result — 徒劳地；白费力气
collocations: try in vain 徒劳尝试
wait in vain 空等
compare: for nothing：白费／无报酬，须看语境。
family: vain adj. 徒劳的／自负的
vocabulary.usage: 本文修饰 try，强调挤在火车上难以编织；不是“虚荣地试着做”。

vocabulary.definition: make fabric by interlocking loops of yarn — 编织；针织
collocations: knit a scarf 织围巾
knit wool 针织毛线
vocabulary.usage: k 不发音。过去式与过去分词可为 knitted 或 knit；不与“缝纫”完全等同。
otherSenses: join closely or heal together — 紧密结合、愈合，如 a close-knit family / a broken bone knitting

vocabulary.definition: a separate section inside a larger space — 隔间；分隔空间
collocations: a train compartment 火车隔间
a luggage compartment 行李舱
vocabulary.usage: 本文 first-class compartments 指一等车厢隔间，和 reserved seats“预订座位”不是同一概念。

vocabulary.definition: relating to Finland; its language — 芬兰的；芬兰语
collocations: a Finnish student 芬兰学生
speak Finnish 说芬兰语
compare: finish：完成，拼写和意义不同但读音相近。
vocabulary.usage: 大写。a Finnish youth 中 youth 才是中心名词；不能用 a Finnish 单独表示一个芬兰人。

vocabulary.definition: a hard round hat with a rounded top — 圆顶硬礼帽
collocations: a bowler hat 圆顶礼帽
wear a bowler 戴圆顶礼帽
compare: bowler：圆顶硬礼帽，也指投球手
cap：通常无全圈帽檐的便帽。
family: bowler n. 圆顶礼帽／投球手
bowl v. 投球（对应投球手义）
vocabulary.usage: 本文 bowler hat 是帽子。不要因为邻近 cricket 就套用“板球投球手”的义项。
otherSenses: n. a person who bowls in cricket or bowling — 板球投球手
保龄球手

vocabulary.definition: light in colour, especially hair or skin — 浅色的；金色的；白皙的
collocations: fair hair 浅色头发
fair skin 白皙皮肤
compare: pale：缺少血色，也可形容一般浅色。
family: fair adj. 浅色的／公平的
fairly adv. 相当地／公平地
vocabulary.usage: 本文 hair is not fair 谈发色，不是“头发不公平”。fairly 不表示“金色地”。
otherSenses: adj. treating people equally — 公平的
adj. acceptable or reasonably good — 尚可的
adj. quite large — 相当多的，如 a fair amount
n. an organized public event — 集市、展会

vocabulary.definition: a line formed by combing hair in opposite directions — 发缝；分发线
collocations: a centre parting 中分
a side parting 侧分
vocabulary.usage: 本文 with almost no parting 指卷发没有明显分界。不是与人告别的“离别”。
otherSenses: n. the act or moment of saying goodbye — 离别、分别

vocabulary.definition: hair growing above the upper lip — 上唇胡须；髭
collocations: grow a moustache 蓄上唇胡须
a thick moustache 浓密的髭
vocabulary.usage: 美式也拼 mustache。原文拿胡须猜国籍，体现人物刻板印象，不是事实性判断标准。

vocabulary.definition: not straight or properly aligned — 弯曲的；歪的
collocations: a crooked nose 歪鼻子
crooked teeth 不整齐的牙齿
compare: crooked：弯曲或歪斜，也可指不诚实
vocabulary.usage: 形容词词尾读 /ɪd/，有两个音节。本文指鼻子外形，不能由此译成“奸诈的鼻子”。
otherSenses: adj. dishonest — 不诚实的、腐败的（非正式）
此义仍读 /ˈkrʊkɪd/

vocabulary.definition: draw the eyebrows together in concern or displeasure — 皱眉
collocations: frown at someone 朝某人皱眉
a worried frown 忧虑的皱眉神情
vocabulary.usage: frown on/upon 是“不赞成”，不是字面朝某物皱眉。本文 is frowning 表当时的面部动作。
otherSenses: n. an expression with eyebrows drawn together — 皱眉的表情
frown on/upon — 不赞成、反对（短语）

vocabulary.definition: not at all — 根本不；绝非
collocations: anything but easy 一点也不容易
anything but ordinary 绝不普通
family: 固定结构：anything but 绝非
vocabulary.usage: 本文 anything but smart 表衣着一点也不整洁漂亮。smart 在此不是“聪明”；but 不连接另一个主句。

vocabulary.definition: a case for carrying documents — 公文包
collocations: carry a briefcase 拎公文包
a leather briefcase 皮质公文包
vocabulary.usage: 由 brief + case 构成，但不按“短箱子”逐字翻译。本文其旧外观误导了 Matti 的判断。

vocabulary.definition: swell or stick out because something is full — 鼓起；凸出
collocations: a bulging pocket 鼓鼓的口袋
bulge with papers 塞满文件而鼓起

otherSenses: n. a rounded part sticking out — 鼓包、凸出部分
n. a temporary increase — 暂时性的激增，如 a population bulge

vocabulary.definition: a device with interlocking teeth used to close an opening — 拉链；拉上拉链
collocations: do up a zip 拉上拉链
zip up a jacket 拉上夹克拉链
vocabulary.usage: 本文 zip-fastener 为较旧的复合名称，现代常直接说 zip 或 zipper。原文的 zip 不指压缩文件。
otherSenses: v. move very quickly — 飞快移动
n. energy — 活力（非正式）
zip a file — 压缩文件（计算机用法）

vocabulary.definition: a device that joins or closes things — 扣件；扣合装置
collocations: a zip fastener 拉链
a metal fastener 金属扣件
vocabulary.usage: t 不发音。fastener 来自 fasten，不是 fast“快”的比较级或做事快的人。

vocabulary.definition: the first letters of a person's names — 姓名首字母
collocations: someone's initials 某人姓名缩写
embroidered initials 绣出的首字母
compare: acronym：由首字母等组成且通常读作一个词的缩略词。
family: initial v. 签姓名首字母
vocabulary.usage: J. S. 仅给出首字母，不能唯一确定为 John Smith。原有音频将缩写保留为一句，不重新切分。
otherSenses: initial adj. first — 最初的
initial v. sign using name initials — 签姓名首字母

vocabulary.definition: a small building used to store tools — 工具棚
collocations: a garden tool shed 花园工具棚

compare: workshop：进行制作维修的工作间。

otherSenses: shed v. lose or give off — 脱落、流出、散发，如 shed leaves / tears / light
与名词 shed 棚屋区分

vocabulary.definition: the colour and appearance of facial skin — 面色；肤色
collocations: a pale complexion 苍白的面色

otherSenses: n. the general character of a situation — 局面的性质、整体面貌

vocabulary.definition: extremely impressive or beautiful — 壮丽的；华美的；令人赞叹的
collocations: a magnificent building 宏伟建筑

pdfNotes.title: form / approach / receptive
pdfNotes.text: follow form 遵循惯例；approach a person 可指向某人接洽，不只表示走近；go-between 在此是代为提亲的中间人；receptive to… 表愿意听取、考虑，不等于已经同意。

pdfNotes.title: 两个 Had 与一个 would
pdfNotes.text: Had he followed… = If he had followed…；破折号中的 had he asked… 补充解释具体礼节；would Chie have been… 才是结果部分的疑问倒装。前两个 Had 是省略 if 的条件倒装，不能当成三个并列疑问句。

pdfNotes.title: 条件句先分时间，再看说话者态度
pdfNotes.text: 一般规律常用 if + 现在式，结果用现在式；开放的将来条件常用 if + 现在式，结果可用 will / can / might 或祈使句。较疏远的现在／将来假设用过去式配 would / could / might；过去反事实常用 had done 配 would / could / might have done。这些是常用框架，不是固定概率刻度。

pdfNotes.title: 图示中应删去的绝对规则
pdfNotes.text: 第二条件句不等于零概率或已知不可能的将来。if 关注条件是否成立，when 通常把事件发生作为预期，不能任意互换。混合条件句按条件和结果各自的时间组合；had done 是过去完成式，不是图中的 present perfect。

pdfNotes.title: 倒装与虚拟语气不靠百分比判断
pdfNotes.text: Had / Were / Should 可引出正式的无 if 条件句；Should you need help, call me. 的结果也能是祈使句。要求类 that 从句可用动词原形，与条件句的过去式形式不同。图中 5%–100% 的要求强度、紧迫度没有可靠量化依据，不作为语法规则。

pdfNotes.title: 原形并非一定由删词得到
pdfNotes.text: They demanded that he leave. 中 leave 是要求类虚拟式，不能说它一定删掉了 must / should；从句也不是“零不定式”。It's time you went. 用过去式表达现在该做的事；也可说 It's time to go，后者是非谓语，不是所谓陈述式时态。

sit beside a brazier 坐在火盆旁
vocabulary.usage: 勿与 brassiere“胸罩”混淆。本文结合矮桌与厚被，呈现传统取暖环境。

vocabulary.definition: a thick stitched bedcover with filling — 被子；夹层绗缝被
collocations: a thick quilt 厚被
a patchwork quilt 拼布被
vocabulary.usage: 本文 quilt 覆在桌边保暖，并非普通床铺语境。spread 是过去式，但形式与原形一样。
otherSenses: v. stitch layers of cloth together — 绗缝、缝制夹层布料

vocabulary.definition: put something securely into a small or protected space — 塞入；掖好
collocations: tuck someone in 给某人掖好被子
tuck a shirt into trousers 把衬衫塞进裤子
compare: tuck：整齐、安全或贴身地塞入
vocabulary.usage: 本文 legs were tucked inside 说明腿藏进被子保暖。过去式 tucked，不双写 k。
otherSenses: n. a stitched fold in clothing — 衣服上的缝褶
tuck somebody in — 给某人掖好被子
tuck into food — 大吃起来（英式非正式）

vocabulary.definition: a hard shiny coating used on wood or metal — 漆；上漆
collocations: a lacquer tray 漆盘
black lacquer 黑漆
compare: lacquer：形成坚硬光亮表面的漆层
vocabulary.usage: 本文 lacquer 作名词定语，指漆制／漆饰托盘，并非托盘盛着一盘漆。
otherSenses: n. a spray for holding hair in place — 定型喷雾，hair lacquer（英式）

vocabulary.definition: relating to teeth or their care — 牙齿的；牙科的
collocations: dental care 牙齿护理
a dental college 牙科学院
vocabulary.usage: dental 是形容词，dentist 才是人。本文出现在名片的院校名称中。

vocabulary.definition: an act of taking something into the body — 吸入；摄入
collocations: an intake of breath 吸一口气
daily salt intake 每日盐摄入量
vocabulary.usage: 本文 a soft intake of air 是轻轻吸气的声音，暗示 Naomi 认得来客；不是入学人数。
otherSenses: n. the amount consumed — 摄入量
n. a group newly admitted — 一届新生、新招收人员
n. an opening taking in air or liquid — 进气口、入口

vocabulary.definition: shine because of reflected light, especially when wet — 闪亮；湿润地发光
collocations: eyes glisten 眼睛闪亮
glisten with rain 带雨水闪光
vocabulary.usage: t 不发音。本文 glistening 修饰 surface，雨水让地面能映出来客的影子。

vocabulary.definition: an open area enclosed by walls or buildings — 庭院；院子
collocations: an inner courtyard 内院
paving stones in a courtyard 庭院铺路石
compare: courtyard：被建筑或墙围合的院子
vocabulary.usage: 不必有花草才是 courtyard。courtyard's 修饰 paving stones，指庭院中的铺石。

vocabulary.definition: extremely wet — 湿透的
collocations: rain-drenched streets 被雨淋透的街道
drenched in sweat 汗流浃背
compare: moist：含适量水分，常中性或正面。
vocabulary.usage: 原词 drench /drentʃ/，加 -ed 后读 /drentʃt/。rain-drenched 是被雨浸湿，不是石头在“淋雨水给别人”。
otherSenses: drenched in light or colour — 沐浴在光线中、充满某种色彩（比喻用法）

vocabulary.definition: polite, cultured and elegant — 文雅的；有教养的
collocations: a refined manner 文雅举止
a refined voice 文雅的声音
compare: sophisticated：老练或精致，含复杂成熟感。
vocabulary.usage: 本文形容 voice，不是化学上的“精炼”。与直接登门的做法形成细微反差：方式破传统，态度仍尊重。
otherSenses: adj. purified or processed — 精炼的、提纯的，如 refined sugar
adj. made more precise — 经改进而精细的

vocabulary.definition: become or make straight; stand upright — 伸直；挺直身子
collocations: straighten up 直起身
straighten one's back 挺直背
vocabulary.usage: 本文是 Akira 鞠躬后直起身，不是“纠正她”。不及物用法，没有宾语。
otherSenses: put things in order — 整理
straighten out — 理顺、解决问题或误会

vocabulary.definition: showing respect for someone's position or wishes — 恭敬的；顺从礼让的
collocations: a deferential manner 恭敬的态度
deferential to elders 对长辈恭敬
family: defer to v. 尊重并听从
vocabulary.usage: defer to“听从”与 defer a meeting“推迟会议”是不同用法。本文形容偷偷一瞥中的尊敬。

vocabulary.definition: a quick or secret look — 偷看；一瞥
collocations: take a peek at 看一眼
peek through the door 从门缝偷看
vocabulary.usage: peek at 后接对象。不要混淆 peak“顶峰”或 pique“激起”；本文 stole a peek 指悄悄瞥了一眼。
otherSenses: v. look quickly or secretly — 偷看、瞥看
sneak peek — 提前预览、抢先看（非正式）

vocabulary.definition: not bright enough to see clearly — 昏暗的；使变暗
collocations: dim light 昏暗光线
dim the lights 调暗灯光
compare: faint：微弱、难察觉，可指光或声。
vocabulary.usage: 本文是光线义，不是口语中“迟钝的”。动词过去式 dimmed，双写 m。
otherSenses: adj. not clearly remembered or understood — 模糊的、依稀的
adj. not intelligent — 迟钝的（非正式、贬义）
v. become weaker — 希望等逐渐减弱

vocabulary.definition: very unpleasant — 糟糕的；令人不快的
collocations: nasty weather 恶劣天气
a nasty smell 难闻气味
compare: cruel：对人残忍，关注行为伤害。
vocabulary.usage: 本文 nasty night 指寒冷多雨的恶劣夜晚，不是把夜晚人格化为“恶毒”。
otherSenses: adj. unkind or malicious — 恶意的、刻薄的
adj. serious or difficult — 严重的、棘手的，如 a nasty injury / problem

vocabulary.definition: relating to a mother or her feelings — 母亲的；母性的
collocations: maternal affection 母爱
maternal grandparents 外祖父母
family: mother n. 母亲（相关基础词）
vocabulary.usage: maternal amusement 指把来客当孩子时的母亲式莞尔，带居高临下的温柔；不是说来客真的就是她儿子。
otherSenses: adj. related through one's mother — 母系的、母亲一方的，如 maternal grandparents

vocabulary.definition: in a way that makes others feel affection — 惹人喜爱地
collocations: endearingly awkward 笨拙得可爱
smile endearingly 可爱地微笑
vocabulary.usage: 孩子说话惹大人怜爱，不等于孩子在“深情地说话”；注意情感的方向。

vocabulary.definition: become red in the face from embarrassment or feeling — 脸红
collocations: blush with embarrassment 因尴尬脸红
a deep blush 满脸通红
compare: flush：也可由热、运动、疾病引起泛红
vocabulary.usage: 不及物；不要写 blush his face。本文没有明说唯一原因，可理解为提亲时羞赧或局促。
otherSenses: n. a reddening of the face — 脸红
n. a pink colour or cosmetic — 淡粉色、腮红（尤美式）

vocabulary.definition: the status of being considered for a role — 候选身份；本文指作为女婿人选的资格
collocations: candidacy for a position 某职位的候选资格
announce one's candidacy 宣布参选
compare: application：提出申请的行为或文件
vocabulary.usage: 本文借用正式候选语汇谈提亲；不宜只译成政治“参选”，也不能擅改为“真心”。

vocabulary.definition: a failure to meet standards of proper social behaviour — 不得体；失礼
collocations: the unseemliness of conduct 行为的不得体
an unseemly proposal 失礼的提议
vocabulary.usage: 较正式且低频，本文适合识别，不必当高频口语背诵。指直接提亲的方式不合惯例，不表示婚事违法。

vocabulary.definition: be essentially a matter of one thing — 归根结底是；取决于
collocations: come down to a choice 归结为一个选择
come down to parental approval 归结为父母同意
compare: come down to：从复杂表面归结核心
vocabulary.usage: to 是介词，后接名词或 -ing。本文不是“下降到”，也不必译成单纯因果“导致”。
otherSenses: be passed from earlier generations — 流传下来，常用 come down to us
be reduced to an amount — 降到某数值，需结合主语与语境

vocabulary.definition: relating to parents — 父母的
collocations: parental approval 父母认可
parental responsibility 父母责任
vocabulary.usage: parent 是可数名词，parents 指父母；parental 是形容词，无复数形式。本文重在长辈对婚事的许可。

vocabulary.definition: permission or agreement freely given — 同意；许可
collocations: give one's consent 给予同意
consent to a proposal 同意提议
vocabulary.usage: 名词常不可数；动词 consent to something / to do something 均可。本文是母亲对婚事的许可，不与赞赏来客混同。
otherSenses: v. agree or give permission — 同意，consent to + 名词／doing，也可 consent to do

vocabulary.definition: suddenly, with little preparation or transition — 突然地；唐突地
collocations: stop abruptly 突然停下
change abruptly 骤然变化
family: abrupt adj. 突然的／生硬的
vocabulary.usage: 本文修饰语气转柔这一变化，不是说柔和的声音本身“粗鲁”。
otherSenses: adv. in a curt, unfriendly way — 生硬地、唐突地

vocabulary.definition: make someone suddenly surprised or slightly frightened — 使惊讶；使吓一跳
collocations: startle someone 使某人一惊
be startled by a noise 被声音吓一跳
vocabulary.usage: I’ve startled you 是完成时，强调已造成她的震动。这里不仅是声响惊吓，更是提亲内容出人意料。

vocabulary.definition: idiom: relax comfortably; here, take away her peace — 习语本义：悠闲休息；本文：带走她的安宁
collocations: take one's ease 舒舒服服休息（较旧式）
feel at ease 感到自在
put someone at ease 使人放松
compare: take one's ease：主语自己休息
take away someone's ease：夺走另一个人的安宁
feel at ease：处于自在状态。
vocabulary.usage: 结合前句 He bowed and left，本句 Taking 的逻辑主语仍是 Akira，her 指 Chie；猫叼鱼比喻他带走她的安宁。这是上下文推断，不按习语“Chie 在休息”解释。
otherSenses: take one's ease means relax — 悠闲休息（旧式）
本文 Taking her ease 是针对这层意思的语境化改写，不再套用该习语

vocabulary.definition: leave with something taken, often stolen — 拿走后溜掉；携物逃走
collocations: make off with the money 带着钱逃走
a cat makes off with a fish 猫叼着鱼溜走
compare: make off with：带着取走的东西离开
run away：逃跑，未必拿了东西。
family: 固定短语 make off with 按整体记忆
vocabulary.usage: 宾语放 with 后，不能分成 make it off with。本文是比喻 Akira 轻巧离开，使 Chie 失去安宁，不是写 Chie 偷鱼。

vocabulary.definition: so unreasonable that it seems absurd — 荒唐的；离谱的
collocations: a preposterous idea 荒唐念头
a preposterous claim 离谱主张
vocabulary.usage: 较正式、评价强烈。本文是 Chie 试图否定求婚者期待的想法，不是叙述者已判定婚事不可能。

vocabulary.definition: a person entitled to inherit property, a title or a position — 继承人
collocations: heir to a fortune 财产继承人
the family heir 家族继承人
compare: heir：继承财产、称号或位置者
successor：接替职位的人，不必继承财产。
vocabulary.usage: h 不发音，故 an heir。heir 可指任何性别；本文 Fuji heir 是 Naomi，不能译成男性“继承儿子”。
otherSenses: n. someone carrying on a role or tradition — 继任者、精神上的继承者，如 heir to a tradition
